quote: One of the greatest and suddenest storms on record ... Saturday evening was as fine as was ever known ... holiday-makers ... Mulgrave Woods, Robin Hood’s Bay

quote: The wind fell away ... at midnight there was a dead calm ... The only sail noticeable was a foreign schooner with all sails set ... efforts were made to signal her to reduce sail

quote: “As idle as a painted ship upon a painted ocean.”

quote: Shortly before ten o’clock the stillness ... the band on the pier ... A little after midnight came a strange sound from over the sea

masses of sea-fog came drifting inland ... the spirits of those lost at sea were touching their living brethren with the clammy hands of death

quote: Some of the scenes thus revealed were of immeasurable grandeur ... the new searchlight ... a fishing-boat ... rushed into the harbour ... a shout of joy

quote: then, mirabile dictu, between the piers, leaping from wave to wave ... lashed to the helm was a corpse ... pitched herself on that accumulation of sand ... Tate Hill Pier.

quote: no one at the moment on Tate Hill Pier ... the coastguard on duty on the eastern side ... was the first to climb on board ... recoiled at once

a doctor ... Surgeon J. M. Caffyn ... declared ... the man must have been dead for quite two days. In his pocket was a bottle ... the addendum to the log.
